summary: Three public Xenopus laevis xenobot RNA-seq series exist in GEO (GSE275807, GSE277182, GSE320387), but their controls are whole age-matched embryos, embryos in different media, or the same xenobots before and after stimulus, rather than intact epidermis; no motility videos or trajectories of dissociated epidermal cells were found in Dryad or BioStudies, and the foundational xenobot paper is not open access.
next_step: Check the GSE275807 sample metadata for tissue type, and pre-register either a transcriptome contrast or a new dissociation-versus-intact motility assay.
obstacles_confirmed: Trial-level videos and counts are not in an independent repository (Dryad 0 hits, BioStudies unrelated hits).
